policy.decision: Apply only these four explicit human-reviewed representative-domain assignments from deterministic SHA1(person_id) shard 2. Preserve existing non-null Production values as authoritative and fail closed on any conflict; perform no Role-to-Domain automation or unrelated reclassification.

review_scope.rationale: Brennus and Miltiades are represented primarily by military command; Artemisia I is represented by her securely dated 480 BCE naval command rather than an undated continuous reign; Mencius is represented by intellectual-philosophical activity.
